offering_description.value: Operates supermarkets in the southeastern United States, selling groceries and household goods to consumers. Many stores also fill prescriptions, sell fuel or offer curbside pickup. The company processes milk for its own stores and wholesale customers and leases space in company-owned shopping centers.

primary_products.value: packaged groceries; fresh produce, meat and bakery goods; household essentials; prescription drugs; motor fuel

primary_services.value: prescription dispensing; online grocery fulfillment and curbside pickup; shopping center leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Grocery shoppers, pharmacy patients and motorists; B2B: Grocery retailers and other wholesale dairy buyers, plus shopping center tenants

end_markets.value: consumer grocery; retail pharmacy; motor fuel retail; dairy wholesale; retail real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: Groceries, household goods, motor fuel, prescription drugs and wholesale dairy products; healthcare reimbursement: Insurer and pharmacy benefit payments for covered prescriptions; rental or leasing: Rent from tenants in company-owned shopping centers
revenue_model.category: product sales; healthcare reimbursement; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Buys groceries, household goods, medicines and fuel for resale to shoppers, patients and motorists; OEM / manufacturer: Processes raw milk into packaged dairy products for its stores and wholesale customers; asset operator: Owns and operates shopping centers with space leased to retail tenants

geography_served.value: US regional: North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Tennessee, Alabama and Virginia

specialization.value: related lines: Supermarkets, in-store pharmacies, fuel centers, dairy processing and shopping center leasing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated supermarkets, in-store pharmacies and fuel centers; online: Grocery ordering for curbside pickup; direct sales: Wholesale dairy sales to commercial buyers and leases to retail tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food safety rules for grocery and dairy operations, state pharmacy licensing and environmental rules for fuel storage
